Admission Status.description: Whether the visit ended in admission or not.

All Visits.description: One value, "All visits", for every ER visit. A single category to stack a breakdown along, such as a 100% bar of admitted versus not admitted.

Arrival Date.description: Calendar date the patient arrived at the ER.

Arrival Day.description: Weekday of the arrival as a short name (Mon ... Sun). Sorts Monday first: each later day carries invisible zero-width spaces in front of its name.

Arrival Week.description: Monday-starting week of the ER arrival.

Department Referral.description: Hospital department the patient was referred on to, or None.

Event Action.description: What they did: raised, started, resolved, closed, reopened, reassigned.

Event Flag ID.description: The flag an audit event belongs to.

Event Note.description: The reason or note given with the change.

Flag Due Date.description: Date the owner is due to report back.

Flag Owner.description: The named person who owns the follow-up.

Flag Scope.description: What the flag is about: a time slot or a department.

Flag Status.description: Open, In progress, Resolved (owner done, awaiting sign-off) or Closed (signed off by the ED operations lead).

Flag Time Band.description: Three-hour arrival band of the flagged time slot, or "Any".

Flag Weekday.description: Weekday of the flagged time slot, or "Any".

Gender.description: Patient gender: Male, Female or Non-Conforming.

Hour of Day.description: Hour of the day the patient arrived, 0-23.

Period.description: Arrival month as a sortable YYYY-MM label, for picking one period.

Race Group.description: Patient self-reported race with labels short enough for chart axes (Native American/Alaska Native shortened).

Review Month.description: Time axis for the morning review: the latest month in the data to its latest day (1-30 Oct 2020 in this extract), compared with the same days of the month before.

Time Band.description: Arrival time in eight 3-hour bands on the 24-hour clock (00-03h is midnight to 3am); labels sort in time order.

Wait Band.description: Minutes waited before being seen, in 10-minute bands (waits run from 10 to 60 minutes). Labels sort in order.

Wait Target.description: Whether the patient was seen within the 30-minute target.

Weekday.description: Day of the week the patient arrived.

Weekday Short.description: Weekday of the arrival, numbered so it sorts Monday first (1 Mon ... 7 Sun).

Admission Rate.description: Share of ER visits that resulted in admission (average of the 0/1 admission flag).

Admitted Patients.description: Number of visits that resulted in the patient being admitted.

Avg Satisfaction.description: Average patient satisfaction score (1-10), across the visits where a score was recorded.

Avg Satisfaction Change vs Last Month.description: Average satisfaction score (1-10, visits with a score), change: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Avg Satisfaction Last Month.description: Average satisfaction score (1-10, visits with a score), for the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Avg Satisfaction This Month.description: Average satisfaction score (1-10, visits with a score), for the latest month to date, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Avg Wait Time.description: Average minutes a patient waits before being seen.

Avg Wait Time Change vs Last Month.description: Average minutes waited before being seen, change: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Avg Wait Time Last Month.description: Average minutes waited before being seen, for the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Avg Wait Time This Month.description: Average minutes waited before being seen, for the latest month to date, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

CSAT Responses.description: Number of visits with a recorded satisfaction score.

Flag Events.description: Number of audit events recorded against flags.

Flags Awaiting Sign-off.description: Flags the owner has marked Resolved and the ED operations lead has not yet closed.

Flags Raised.description: Number of waiting-time flags raised by duty managers.

Open Flags.description: Flags not yet resolved: status Open or In progress.

Overdue Flags.description: Open or in-progress flags whose due date is before today.

Patients.description: Count of ER patient visits, one row per visit.

Patients Change vs Last Month.description: ER visits, change: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Patients Change vs Last Month Guarded.description: ER visits, change on the same days of the month before (Review Month axis); empty when the month before has no visits, so the earliest month shows no invented change.

Patients Last Month.description: ER visits, for the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Patients Over Target.description: Number of ER visits that waited longer than the target (30 minutes unless the Target Minutes parameter is set).

Patients Over Target Change vs Last Mont.description: Visits that waited longer than 30 minutes change: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis.

Patients Over Target Last Month.description: Visits that waited longer than 30 minutes for the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis.

Patients Over Target This Month.description: Visits that waited longer than 30 minutes for the latest month to date, on the Review Month axis.

Patients This Month.description: ER visits, for the latest month to date, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Referral Rate.description: Share of ER visits referred on to a hospital department.

Referred Patients.description: Number of visits referred on to a hospital department.

Satisfaction Rank Basis.description: Average satisfaction score (1-10), identical to Avg Satisfaction; a separate item so a table can rank by it beside the score column.

Seen Within 30 per 100 Visits.description: Visits seen within 30 minutes per 100 visits: the same figure as Seen Within Target % on a 0-100 scale. Used where a table ranks by it next to the percentage column (a table column format applies to every column of the same measure).

Seen Within Target %.description: Share of ER visits seen within the waiting-time target (30 minutes unless the Target Minutes parameter is set): visits waiting no longer than the target divided by all visits. Ratio of counts, so it re-weights correctly under any selection.

Seen Within Target % Change vs Last Mont.description: Share of visits seen within 30 minutes, change: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Seen Within Target % Last Month.description: Share of visits seen within 30 minutes, for the same days of the month before, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Seen Within Target % This Month.description: Share of visits seen within 30 minutes, for the latest month to date, on the Review Month axis (latest month to date compared with the same days of the month before).

Seen Within Target pts Change vs Last Mo.description: Change in the share of visits seen within 30 minutes, in percentage points: latest month to date minus the same days of the month before (Review Month axis).

Share of Over-Target Patients.description: This row's share of all visits that waited longer than 30 minutes in the current selection: over-target visits in the row divided by over-target visits across the whole result.

Share of Patients.description: Share of all patient visits in the current selection that fall in this row: visits in the row divided by visits across the whole result.

Waited Over Target % This Month.description: Share of visits that waited longer than 30 minutes, for the latest month to date on the Review Month axis: 1 minus Seen Within Target % This Month. For the headline sentence.
